{"reason": "6 of 8 failure rows are low-trust changes (confidence 0.44-0.67, e.g. pct=0.224 conf=0.44; pct=0.203 conf=0.6). Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) as a fourth gate filters these while true needs carry confidence >= 0.7, cutting false-arbitration-rate from 0.714 without breaching the recall >= 0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
